name: Corporate Dynamic Vector
description: Ultra-clean modern corporate look: smooth gradient background, sharp 3D vector wave elements at the borders, and a highly isolated subject.
magic_media_keywords: Ultra-clean modern corporate aesthetic, smooth gradient background, sharp 3D vector wave elements at the borders, brilliant softbox lighting, highly isolated subject, professional agency presentation style.
palette_hint: clean corporate gradient (e.g. #0057FF to #00B4D8) anchored with a near-white (#F8FAFC) for legible contrast
best_for: tech launches, SaaS products, and professional agency presentations needing a clean, modern corporate gradient look

graphic_composition.person_cutout: Clean-edged isolated product shot or device silhouette, flat vector rendering with no background bleed, centred below the headline zone, softbox-lit with no rim spill — the subject floats on the gradient with a subtle drop shadow for depth separation.
graphic_composition.cta_button: Rounded pill button (border-radius 40 px) with the corporate gradient as fill and white bold sans-serif text, placed in the bottom-right quadrant with generous surrounding negative space so it anchors the visual hierarchy without crowding the headline. CTA text MUST be 2-4 words imperative ('Start Free Trial', 'Get Early Access').
graphic_composition.giant_typography: One single keyword from the headline set at 4-6× body scale behind the main headline layer, 12-15% opacity, same font family as the headline, positioned to overlap the vector wave elements so the oversized type and the waves create a single cohesive graphic mass.
graphic_composition.badge: Small rounded pill badge (height ~32 px) in a solid palette accent colour with white text, placed in the top-right corner or directly above the CTA. Typical content: 'NEW', '2026', 'v2.0', or a price point like '$49/mo'. Must feel like a UI component — clean stroke, no drop shadow.
